# 航空发动机资料库

_Aero-Engine Knowledge Library_

按主题阅读、按来源核对，把基础原理、工程方法和公开资料连成一张知识地图。

_Read by topic, verify against sources, and connect fundamentals, engineering methods and public references._

**10 个一级主题 · 30 篇专题导读 · 13 份公开 PDF**。

_10 subject areas · 30 topic guides · 13 public PDFs._

## 参考书与性能主线 / Reference Book & Performance Route

参考 Walsh 与 Fletcher《Gas Turbine Performance》，按“整机匹配、全工况、全寿命”组织学习。三个词是本站的阅读提炼。

_Use Walsh and Fletcher’s Gas Turbine Performance to connect whole-engine matching, the operating envelope and service life. These are this site’s organising themes._

[燃气涡轮性能阅读指南 / Gas Turbine Performance — Reading Guide](#books/wiki?page=327) · [性能术语与符号 / Performance Terminology & Symbols](#books/wiki?page=328)

工作条件与参数 → 设计点与匹配 → 瞬态与低转速工况 → 试验、在役与经济性。

_Conditions and parameters → design and matching → dynamics and low-speed operation → testing, service and economics._
